task: Route a ticket that reports two unrelated problems owned by different teams. The point is to see the ambiguity in the probabilities, not to force one label.
code_rule: Route only when confidence >= 0.8. Below that, send to triage with the probabilities shown. If two-problem tickets are common, replace the choice with one noul per team so both can fire.
